correctness.rationale: Every diagonal matching-field vertex occupies k positions within the active k by (n-k+1) band, one per row. All lie on the sphere around the uniform row coordinate c, of squared radius k-k/(n-k+1). Consecutive blocks cover each active coordinate exactly once, so their centroid is c; averaging ||v_s-q||^2=R^2+||q-c||^2 proves both optimality and uniqueness without reliance on affine-dimension details. The source p.5 supplies exact vertices; the source p.7 confirms dimension. Independently enumerated all vertices for (n,k)=(5,2),(7,3),(9,5), obtaining 10,35,126 equal-distance contacts and correct squared radii.
